prior_access: Previous Han experiments retained as smoke/development; 88 raw pairs and 91 published pairs previously scored, published tables and raw counts accessed; no claim that the entire study is untouched.
primary: Execute v2 scalar control on common panel; all 3 rank1 sources, 5 seeds, 3 folds, both readouts.
secondary: Same rules for spectral, SF12 and V4; no choice of source or model by Han score.
common_panel: all raw-qualified common identities; published sensitivity on identical pairs
full_han: Enumerate every distinct noncontrol pair with finite singles. Raw eligibility unchanged: initial count >=50, plasmid>0, >=3 constructs with both orientations. Published panel: all finite distinct pairs with allowed singles.
extended_adapter: Target additive B; shared frozen source feature function supplies raw D. Source endpoint shifts omitted because P annihilates them on the known panel; missing gene-index M0 is not imputed. Deploy B+alpha*P_Q D. This is an explicitly new no-base-retraining adapter, not the original full source model.
extended_features: Restore SF12 linear source knowledge transform using source embeddings only. Use source mean for V4 centering, per-gene RMS, frozen weights and original two seeds. All scales and source beta unchanged. Missing external knowledge uses the pre-existing global mean policy, with identity-level flags.
extended_endpoints: B fixed; component and whole shrink of a pure partner vector are identical and are not counted as distinct wins.
extended_primary_metric: Target-calibrated partner SSE vs both alpha1 and alpha0; complete SSE vs B. All 6 source-family variants reported without selecting a winner.
gamma: same pool full-loss coefficient for original-model common panel only
projection: Each held-out scientific panel separately. Compute via small endpoint Gram solve; no N by N projection for full Han.
readouts: raw_repeats primary; published reported in full with its own single inputs. Full panels may differ due raw qualification; report coverage and no isolated readout-effect claim.
checks: portable feature direction equality after projection on common panel
stopping: No search, no new seeds, no post-score parameter edits. Checkpoint every fold; all variants retained.
